key_insight: AgenTAP explores using a vision-language model as an agent to track the same physical point across images or video. The aim is to move beyond recognizing objects to locating precise points as their appearance and visibility change.
problem_solved: Point correspondence requires identifying the exact same physical surface point across observations, including after appearance changes or temporary disappearance—a task that remains challenging for general-purpose vision-language models.
method: Introduce AgenTAP, a vision-language-model-based agent for point tracking.
Frame tracking around pixel-level correspondence rather than object-level recognition.

impact: This approach could extend general-purpose vision-language models to fine-grained visual tracking. The supplied excerpt does not establish tracking accuracy or performance relative to specialist models.
